name: agile-mods
description: Claude Mods for the agile-skills loop: /agile-board sprint board above the prompt (build and merge queues, drain pass and outcome, links pane, retro counts); guards that enforce agent tool grants, the reviewed-sha merge gate, base-branch proof and untrusted-output fences; /receipts checks agent receipts against the contract; and, in the agile-skills repo, trigger-phrase, MCP-name, version-bump and invariant checks. Needs function hooks (early access, CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1); installs and does nothing without them.
